notes: «عن أبيه» with no name is a relation link (rule 7)
«قال قال علي عليه السلام» names Ali after the chain as the speaker of the saying: last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
The stray «- وَ-» before «فِي رِوَايَةِ» is punctuation and is ignored

fixes.reason: THQ's English names the father of Imam Jafar, which the Arabic writes only as «أبيه».

evidence.quote: from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as)
